hero.description: Web hosting, websites and business systems built around you, wherever you work. From your online presence to automation and AI, I connect creative thinking with practical technology.

sections.description: Give your business website or online store a dependable home, with hosting, SSL certificates, malware protection and automated backups shaped around your needs.
sections.note: Storage, protection, backup schedules and support are agreed around your platform and project scope.

sections.description: Business websites, online stores and HTML email templates shaped around your brand and customers. Responsive design, clear information and straightforward journeys help people enquire, explore and buy.
Your business has its own processes, challenges and goals. I build custom systems around how you work—from focused tools that solve one problem to connected platforms supporting multiple teams.
points: CRM and sales pipelines, quoting and invoicing, bookings
Project and job tracking, stock and asset management, customer and supplier portals
Staff workflows, dashboards, reporting and integrations

about.description: I’m a designer, founder and builder. My work sits at the intersection of design, entrepreneurship and practical problem-solving—and I don’t believe the best ideas stay in one lane.
about.second: I start by understanding what you want to achieve. Then we work out what’s worth building, and how to make it work for the people using it.
